name: cavemio-card-deck
title: Card deck
description: A tactile stack that fans out, follows your hand, and deals the next card with a measured flick.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Left and Right on the front card browse the collection. Previous and Next buttons offer equivalent pointer and touch controls.
- Only the front card is focusable. Back cards and the departing copy are inert and hidden from assistive technology.
- Links, buttons, form inputs and elements marked data-deck-no-drag keep their own interactions without starting a card drag.
- Vertical touch scrolling is preserved. Pointer cancellation returns the card, and a pause before release does not count as a flick.
- Reduced motion removes dragging transforms, fanning and animated exits. Gestures still select cards, with immediate state changes.
- The collection wraps. Empty collections render no controls; one-card collections disable browsing.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: It fans out
features.description: Hover or focus the front card and the cards behind open slightly, so people can see there is more.

features.title: It follows your hand
features.description: The front card tracks the pointer with a slight rotation while the next one rises.

features.title: It deals on a flick
features.description: Drag past about a quarter of the card’s width, or flick, and the card is dealt away from where you let go.

features.title: It springs back
features.description: An unfinished drag returns on a damped spring that keeps the speed of your release.

features.title: Your content in every card
features.description: renderCard draws anything. Links, buttons and inputs inside a card keep their own behaviour.

features.title: Works without dragging
features.description: Arrow keys and Previous and Next buttons browse the deck, and vertical touch scrolling still works.

states.title: rest
states.description: Up to four cards are visible, with 12px spacing and a 5.5% size difference between layers.

states.title: fan
states.description: Hover or keyboard focus opens the stack to 17px spacing and a slight alternating rotation.

states.title: drag
states.description: The front card follows the pointer without React updates on each frame. Every card has its own compositor layer, and the cards behind are moved directly as the next one rises in proportion to the drag, so nothing repaints mid-gesture.

states.title: deal
states.description: Cross 27% of the card’s width (at most 100px), or flick intentionally, to deal a card. The outgoing card continues from the release position.

states.title: return
states.description: An incomplete or cancelled drag returns along a sampled damped spring over 520ms, using the release velocity.
